definition: to rub something with a brush
description: A marble salon with warm lights and shelves of bottles. A lion sits in a salon chair in a black cape with its head tipped back over a white washbasin. A ginger cat in a white coat sits on its head and works white foam into the mane, then rinses it out with a shower head, so the wet mane hangs down dark and heavy into the basin. The cat then takes a large wooden hairbrush and pulls it down through the long wet mane, stroke after stroke, working out the tangles from the top of the head to the ends hanging over the basin. In the last shots the lion sits up facing the camera with the mane brushed out full and dry, and the cat perched on a stool beside it.
